The Bewilderment.name: The Bewilderment
The Bewilderment.description:
The afflicted creature's mind is gripped by @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}, a creeping arcane confusion that does not relent.

  • The afflicted suffers the @Condition[disoriented] condition for as long as the curse persists.

  • The afflicted creature's maximum Morale is reduced by half.

  • The mind's fraying defenses leave the afflicted Vulnerable to Corruption damage, suffering -5 resistance.

Blessing of Abyss.name: Blessing of Abyss
Blessing of Abyss.description: You are blessed by the power of Abyss. While this blessing endures, your attunement to Abyss is heightened, granting +5 attunement points toward your effective rank, which may temporarily elevate your Abyss attunement to a higher rank.

Kaleidoscopic Confusion.name: Kaleidoscopic Confusion
Kaleidoscopic Confusion.description:
You are befuddled, your thoughts clouded, and words jumbled. You have trouble speaking coherently. You are affected by the @Condition[disoriented] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Kaleidoscopic Fatigue.name: Kaleidoscopic Fatigue
Kaleidoscopic Fatigue.description:
The light from the crystal saps all of your energy. You are overtaken by an unnatural wave of lethargy and you gain the @Condition[exhausted] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Kaleidoscopic Focus.name: Kaleidoscopic Focus
Kaleidoscopic Focus.description:
Your mind becomes sharp and resilient against distractions. You gain the benefits of the @Condition[resolute] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Kaleidoscopic Glare.name: Kaleidoscopic Glare
Kaleidoscopic Glare.description:
All light becomes painful and overwhelming for your eyes. You suffer the effects of the @Condition[blinded] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Kaleidoscopic Haunting.name: Kaleidoscopic Haunting
Kaleidoscopic Haunting.description:
You hear ominous whispers in the shadows all around you. These voices are all you can hear and you suffer the effects of the @Condition[deafened] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Kaleidoscopic Intoxication.name: Kaleidoscopic Intoxication
Kaleidoscopic Intoxication.description:
You feel unsteady on your feet, your limbs are sluggish, and your mind is dulled. You are affected by the @Condition[exposed] condition.

This effect lasts until the affected character completes a Rest. It can be removed early by using [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=influence inflection=push dc=14]].

Luminous Crystallization.name: Luminous Crystallization
Luminous Crystallization.description:
The afflicted creature's flesh is slowly transmuted into a luminous, crystalline substance by the touch of an Uncanny Relic. The transformation is painful and spreading, hardening the limbs and creeping inexorably toward the core.

  • The afflicted suffers the @Condition[slowed] condition as crystalline rigidity takes hold of their body.

  • The brittle crystal is easily shattered and corroded: the afflicted is Vulnerable to Bludgeoning and Acid damage, suffering -5 resistance to each.

  • Conversely, the luminous crystal drinks in light, granting +10 Radiant resistance.

Ward of Stabilization.name: Ward of Stabilization
Ward of Stabilization.description: This protective ward calls upon the earth below to provide +5 Resistance to Acid damage by causing the elements needed to neutralize the corrosive liquid to spontaneously manifest when the warded individual is struck.

Ward of Thunder.name: Ward of Thunder
Ward of Thunder.description:
This retributive ward calls upon the sky above to cause a booming thunder clap to resound back upon any enemy who strikes the warded character with a melee attack.

[[/hazard 6 fortitude lightning morale]]{Retributive Thunderclap}
